verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a public API/SDK surface (Python, TypeScript, REST) for creating tasks, running multi-step browser automations, and extracting structured data via JSON schema, matching the ai-native 'drive via documented API' story; it also ships an MCP server for agent control. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s for all candidate paths) and independent/hands-on confirmation of API robustness beyond first-party docs.
